t.zh: 检修员接来一台无标签的仪器。自己画输入，找出亮点去了哪里。提交的图必须让几种猜测给出不同结果。
t.en: A technician connects an unlabelled instrument. Draw an input and track where its bright readings go. Your submission must distinguish competing explanations.

brief.zh: 设计一张能区分三种移动方向的图。运行后，按输出提交判断。
brief.en: Design an image that distinguishes the three directions. Run it and submit the conclusion supported by the output.

hint.zh: 用一个位置明确、远离图边的亮点作记号。
hint.en: Use a single bright marker well away from the image boundary.

after.zh: 输出亮点往左移动时，每格是在向右读取输入。读偏移描述去哪里找数据，和亮点移动的方向相反。 <wiki-ref to="read-offset"></wiki-ref>
after.en: When a bright spot moves left in the output, each cell is reading to its right. Read offset describes where to fetch the data, opposite the apparent motion. <wiki-ref to="read-offset"></wiki-ref>
